notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Wirewood Channeler.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.
